resume_text:
DR. AISHA RAHMAN
Computer Vision Engineer | Manchester, UK

EXPERIENCE

Computer Vision Engineer, Northgate Robotics
January 2021 - Present
- Train and deploy object detection models (YOLOv8, PyTorch) for warehouse robots.
- Built the annotation review pipeline used by the labelling team.
- Reduced false positives on the pallet detector, measured on our internal test set.

Research Assistant, University of Manchester
October 2017 - December 2020
- Published work on self-supervised depth estimation.
- Implemented experiments in PyTorch and OpenCV.

PROJECTS

DepthFold
Open-source implementation of a monocular depth estimation network. PyTorch, ONNX.

EDUCATION

PhD Computer Science, University of Manchester, 2017 - 2021
MEng Electronic Engineering, University of Leeds, 2013 - 2017

SKILLS

Python, PyTorch, OpenCV, NumPy, ONNX, CUDA, Docker
